_comment: Review-only data for /review/ (built only when PUBLIC_REVIEW_ROUTES=1). Measurements are filled from qa/heroes-2026-10-10/ results; nothing here is shown on production pages.

options.name: Phone, pipe, logo
options.story: One short ring of a phone, a red line runs through a pipe bend, and the line arrives at Shane's unchanged logo as a panel slides off it. The call reaches the person on the logo.
options.motion: Phone wobbles once (0.5 s), red line draws through the pipe (0.35-1.0 s), cover slides off the logo (0.95-1.35 s). Then still.

options.name: The logo picks up
options.story: A dark charcoal band, with the logo on a white plate like the decal on the white van. Beside it a desk phone's receiver lifts off its cradle once and stays lifted: the call is answered.
options.motion: Two ring marks flash once (0.6 s); the receiver lifts and settles (0.3-0.85 s). Then still.

options.name: Plumbing diagram
options.story: Drawn on grid paper like a riser diagram: a leaking tap, a water heater and a radiator (leak, no hot water, no heat) pipe into one line, through a valve, to Shane's logo. Whatever the problem, it runs to one person.
options.motion: Red flow lines draw from each fixture to the logo (0.1-1.3 s). Then still.

options.name: Van lettering
options.story: Headline first, then a white panel that reads like the side of Shane's van: his italic bullet list, the logo decal and the license line, with a pipe and a wrench along the bottom like the van's rocker panel.
options.motion: The pipe slides in (0.5 s) and the wrench turns once as if tightening (0.25-0.95 s). Then still.
options.caveat: The van also says Furnaces; it is left off until Shane confirms he offers furnace work (owner question S5).

options.name: A plumber answers
options.story: A simple, original drawing of a plumber in a charcoal work shirt and red cap lifts a phone to his ear beside the logo. Friendly and direct.
options.motion: Two ring marks flash once (0.55 s); the arm lifts the phone to the ear (0.35-0.95 s). Then still.
options.caveat: Proposed brand extension, not Shane's likeness. The character is new artwork and needs Shane's approval before any public use; it would also need a decision on whether it appears anywhere else (van, cards, Google profile).
